spots.name: Briežkalns

park.headline: Freestyle / park: skiable from Mon 30 Nov (100% of 8 models agree), staying good for about 7 days
lines: To open, Briežkalns needs about 3,960 m³ of machine snow for the central run (about 1,800 m³ of water). With 5 snow guns (2 new fan guns + 3 older guns) that is roughly 39 hours of snowmaking at −5 °C wet-bulb (74 h at −3 °C, 23 h at −10 °C); the snowpark brings the total to 7,298 m³, about 72 hours at −5 °C.
Earliest ski day (snowpark ready): Mon 30 Nov, the day after the guns finish (9 of 9 models get there, models range Sun 29 Nov to Mon 30 Nov). First weekend day: Sat 5 Dec.
Natural snow alone does not get there (peak natural cover about 3.5 cm).
First meaningful snowfall: Mon 23 Nov (about 0.7 cm, 91% of models).
Snowmaking weather starts Wed 25 Nov (9 h below the wet-bulb limit that day; 244 h across the horizon).

Weeks ahead (low confidence): freezing weeks become more likely than not from the week of Mon 23 Nov (100% of 50 members), and snowmaking-grade cold (week averaging below -3 C) from the week of Mon 30 Nov (88%).
